name: winlog
description: Test tool: saves SwirlRun's messages for a Windows program to a log file.
author: Swirl
title: Win Log
tagline: Log file for Windows programs (test tool).
long:
Runs a Windows program (or installer) and writes everything SwirlRun reports to /home/user/.windows/swirlrun.log.
Type: winlog /home/user/Downloads/setup.exe
When it gets stuck, open the log in Files (turn on .* to see .windows).
Remove it when done: spm remove winlog
